title: Neon Fare: a neon taxi game where you can talk to your passengers.
author: wwlima
selftext:
So I finally put Neon Fare on itch.io.

It's a night taxi game in a neon city: you pick people up, drive them across town, and you can talk to them on the way.

Every ride ends up being a small conversation, which was the whole idea for me.

There's a main quest with 10 missions, and you've got ratings, earnings and a few different rider types to deal with along the way.

Big credit to Claude here. It made the assets and wrote all the code. The writing and the direction are mine though.

Play it here: [https://wes-albur.itch.io/neon-fare](https://wes-albur.itch.io/neon-fare)

If you guys are interested, feel free to give some feedback. I'm especially curious whether talking to the passengers is fun or just slows the ride down.
